title: Change classification
root_cause: Repair proof selection lacks one canonical deterministic change-class vocabulary.
source_requirement: Classify changes as DOC_ONLY, METADATA_ONLY, SEMANTIC, BEHAVIORAL, SCHEMA, AUTHORITY, RUNTIME, or RELEASE_CRITICAL.
affected_tests: Affected proof and release boundary tests.
evidence_required: Boundary vectors for every class and conservative fallback.
rollback: Disable automatic classification and require explicit highest-risk class.
acceptance_criteria: Unknown or mixed changes cannot reduce required proof.
